stimulus.setup:
Scenario: The players are in a superflat Minecraft garden area. Chat is disabled. The group task is to decorate flower beds and keep the central path clear so everyone can reach the shared chest.
Map layout: {'world': 'superflat', 'garden_area': 'x=-8..8, z=-8..8', 'riley_flower_bed': 'x=-4..0, z=0..4', 'morgan_flower_bed': 'x=4..8, z=0..4', 'shared_chest': 'x=0, y=64, z=-4', 'narrow_path': 'x=-1..1, z=-4..4', 'signal_lamp': 'x=0, y=64, z=8', 'observer_line': 'x=-6,0,6, z=-2'}

normal_cooperative_actions.Morgan: Morgan plants two flowers in Morgan's flower bed and walks toward the central narrow path.
normal_cooperative_actions.Riley: Riley plants red flowers in Riley's flower bed, walks toward the shared chest for more flowers, and pauses at the central narrow path.
normal_cooperative_actions.Casey: Casey places two leaf blocks along the garden edge.
normal_cooperative_actions.Taylor: Taylor checks flower stacks in the shared chest.
normal_cooperative_actions.Jordan: Jordan places one marker block near the signal lamp.

stimulus.target_action: Riley plants red flowers in Riley's flower bed, walks toward the shared chest for more flowers, and pauses at the central narrow path.
stimulus.scripted_visible_incident: Morgan stands in the central narrow path facing Riley. Riley pauses in front of Morgan and turns toward the shared chest. Morgan remains still and continues facing Riley. Riley steps to the right side of the path; Morgan steps to the same side and stops there. Riley steps left; Morgan shifts left and again stands still without placing or breaking blocks.

source_actions.scripted_visible_incident: Morgan stands in the central narrow path facing Riley. Riley pauses in front of Morgan and turns toward the shared chest. Morgan remains still and continues facing Riley. Riley steps to the right side of the path; Morgan steps to the same side and stops there. Riley steps left; Morgan shifts left and again stands still without placing or breaking blocks.

observer_actions.Casey: Casey moves into the narrow path beside Morgan, places a fence post on the edge of Casey’s side to mark a lane, sidesteps into the lane shoulder-to-shoulder with Morgan, and walks forward toward the shared chest to open a clear passage for Riley.
observer_actions.Taylor: Taylor steps back two blocks from the path, turns to face both Morgan and Riley, pauses for three seconds, then walks along the grass edge around them to the shared chest and opens it.
observer_actions.Jordan: Jordan walks to the narrow path edge, places two temporary blocks to widen the lane, gently bumps Morgan one step aside by moving into them, steps back to show the open route, then walks through to the shared chest.

source_actions.target_reaction: Riley takes two slow steps backward out of the narrow path, turns slightly toward the open garden space to the left, and walks a wide arc around the flower beds toward a spot near Casey at the garden edge, stopping there and facing the shared chest while waiting.
